title: [593] Gallium vs. Titalium - Abus Padlock Meets a Gruesome End
summary: LockPickingLawyer shows what happens when liquid gallium is applied to an aluminum Abus padlock, which weakens and breaks the metal. It is a short demonstration of gallium's effect on aluminum.
why: HN points to it whenever gallium or liquid metal comes up, as a vivid demonstration of gallium destroying aluminum.

quote.text: you should watch his video where he breaks a lock by simply applying Gallium to a lock
